description: Base-tier (lowest 30-day volume) taker fee in percent of notional, per venue, as a step function of the effective date. The round-trip arbitrage band of a venue pair is the sum of the two venues' taker fees (two taker legs, no transfer cost, no spread). Status: 'secondary' = stated in a dated third-party news article that was fetched and read; 'inferred' = the rate follows from an article but the effective date is inferred; 'unverified' = remembered or found only in undated reviews, not confirmed. Wayback Machine snapshots could not be fetched from this environment (fetch of web.archive.org refused), and the venues' own fee pages return 403 to automated fetches, so no entry is verified against a primary archived fee page. High-volume accounts pay less than the base tier, so the band is an upper bound for a professional arbitrageur.

bitfinex.note: Bitfinex blog post dated 2015-08-05: from 2015-08-17 the base tier (under $500,000 30-day volume) is 0.10% maker / 0.20% taker. Fetched 2026-10-20. That the base tier stayed unchanged through 2023 is NOT confirmed (no dated source found for 2016-2023); support.bitfinex.com returned 403.

coinbase.note: GDAX per-order-book taker fees in 2017 (remembered as 0.25% BTC-USD, 0.30% ETH-USD); 0.30% used for both. No dated 2017 source found.

Yahoo Finance article dated 2019-03-18: before 2019-03-22 the lowest tier paid 0.30% total, taker only, makers nothing. The Coinbase blog post 'Improving our Fee Schedule' (tiered taker 0.30% under $10M, makers 0%; effective April 5, year not shown in search snippet; page returned 403) is the likely origin; the 2018 year is inferred.

Yahoo (2019-03-18): from 2019-03-22 the lowest tier pays 0.40% total split between maker and taker. Decrypt (2019-10-04) gives the old rates as 0.15% maker / 0.25% taker, consistent with 0.40% total; taker 0.25% is read from that.

Decrypt article dated 2019-10-04: accounts under $10,000 30-day volume move to 0.5% maker / 0.5% taker 'on Monday' (2019-10-07 inferred). The Block, 2022-09-19, says tiers below $100,000 stayed unchanged in the 2022-09-20 revision, supporting 0.50% through 2022.

Advanced Trade lowest tier ($0-$10K): up to 0.6% per trade (NerdWallet, undated snapshot); Coinbase Pro was shut down in 2023. The date the 0.60% base tier applied is not confirmed; 2023-01-01 is an assumption.

bitstamp.note: Flat volume-tier schedule: 0.50% under $10,000 30-day volume, 0.25% under $20,000 (Motley Fool, undated snapshot). No dated source for 2017-2020 found; CoinDesk page 404.
Maker-taker schedule: base paid tier 0.30% maker / 0.40% taker (0% on the first $1,000). Introduction date not found (app release notes suggest about 2020); 2021-01-01 is an assumption.
